channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Wednesday Club Night
item.description: St. Patrick’s Day may be over, but Wednesday Club Night is here with two courts in action, Grade 7 Mens Navan ‘B’ vs Oldcastle in the Meath Cup, and juvenile league matches.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night (Matches Only)
item.description: It’s matches only tonight with three fixtures (G2 Mens, G6 Ladies, G7 Mixed). No courts for members. Juvenile Club Night: Girls 6:30pm, Boys 7:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: National Napping Day… but Monday Club Night won’t wait!
item.description: National Napping Day or not, Monday Club Night is on at Claremont: Grade 2 Ladies Navan ‘B’ vs Navan ‘A’, two courts available from 8:30pm, and Juveniles at 6:30pm (Girls) and 7:30pm (Boys).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: League Action at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Wednesday Club Night at Claremont Stadium Grade 2 Mens (Navan vs Julianstown), Grade 6 Mixed (Navan ‘A’ vs Mullagh), plus two courts open from 8:30pm. Juvenile night is league matches only.'
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Club Night – Wednesday at Navan Badminton Club
item.description: This Wednesday at Navan Badminton Club: Grade 4 Mixed (Navan B vs Mullingar A) and Grade 5 Men’s (Navan A vs Ardee A). Two courts available for members from 8:30pm; Juvenile Club from 6:30pm is league matches only.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: Navan 'A' vs Trim 'A' + Members’ Courts from 8pm
item.description: Cup action this Wednesday as Navan 'A' take on Trim 'A' in the Grade 5 Men’s cup match. Two courts available for members from 8pm, with juveniles playing league matches only.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium: Matches, Members Courts & Juveniles
item.description: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium with two action-packed matches (Grade 2 Ladies: Navan A vs Navan B, Grade 4 Mens: Navan vs WSBC), two member courts from 9pm, and juvenile sessions (Girls 6:30pm, Boys 7:30pm).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night
item.description: Celebrate National Hugging Day at Wednesday Club Night—Grade 2 Ladies cup match (Navan 'A' v Ardee), two courts free from 8pm, and league-only action for juveniles.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont
item.description: Two home matches at Claremont—Navan 'A' vs Kildalkey (Grade 2 Mixed) and Navan vs Drumree (Grade 7 Mens) — plus member courts from 9pm and Juvenile Club Night from 6:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium ☕
item.description: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium featuring Grade 4 Mixed: Navan 'B' vs Mullingar 'A', plus juvenile sessions and extra courts for members from 8:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us for another exciting Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium. Last chance to register for a Meath League team and watch our juveniles make their grand return!
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
